comparison.objective: Seat and tighten a positive battery cable clamp on its tapered post with correct cable orientation.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a spring-loaded clamp, seat it fully, and torque one pinch nut with a wrench.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires seating, 5–7 N·m nut torque, lug alignment, safe wrench placement, hand clearance, and stillness; high, crooked, misplaced, or moved assemblies fail.
comparison.reason: This is the closest threaded-tool record, but it tightens one clamp nut to a torque after seating; the candidate uniquely requires simultaneous driver counterholding to preserve a continuous stop setting and repeated articulated-cycle retention.
